component-o.description-s: The TPS259573DSG is a highly integrated eFuse (electronic fuse / hot-swap controller) with programmable overvoltage lockout (OVLO), providing circuit protection and power management in a small WSON-8 package. It operates from 2.7 V to 18 V input (20 V absolute maximum), with a low 34-mΩ typical on-resistance. The device includes active-low enable with adjustable programmable overvoltage lockout threshold, adjustable current limit from 0.5 A to 4 A (±7.5% accuracy) with a load-current monitor output (ILM), adjustable output slew rate control (dVdt), over-temperature protection, and a fault indication pin (FLT). The device automatically retries after thermal shutdown events. The OVLO threshold can be set by a resistor divider to a user-defined voltage level. Operating junction temperature range is –40°C to +125°C.

pins-ao.1: dVdt - capacitor connection from this pin to GND sets the output turn-on slew rate. Leave floating for fastest turn-on slew rate.

pins-ao.2: EN/OVLO - active low enable input. A resistor divider can be used to adjust the overvoltage lockout threshold. Do not leave floating.

pins-ao.6: FLT - fault event indicator, pulled low when a fault is detected. Open-drain output that requires an external pull-up resistance.

pins-ao.7: ILM - dual function pin used to limit and monitor the output current. An external resistor from this pin to GND sets the output current limit. The pin voltage can also be used to monitor the output load current. Do not leave floating.

pins-ao.9: GND (thermal pad) - the exposed pad is used primarily for heat dissipation and must be connected to GND.

cfgpins-ao.2c: Active-low enable with adjustable programmable overvoltage lockout. Resistor divider (R1 from VIN to EN, R2 from EN to GND) sets OVLO threshold. VOVLO rising threshold is 1.2 V (typ). Device turns off when EN/OVLO exceeds threshold.
